briefdescription.para: The implementation of login, logout and session bookkeeping. (Originally: "Implementation for sessionmanager: Reads the stored password hash after checking the account exists and is active.").

detaileddescription.para: This file reads a client's stored hash, verifies the supplied password, records login/logout times, and manages the in-memory session cache. Tokens are decoded and compared to the stored session in constant time to stop forged tokens hijacking an account.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: This is where a username/password becomes a trusted session. GateKeeper calls it for login and logout; the session data it stores is what later requests rely on to know who is calling. Without it, no one could sign in or out.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
JWT (JSON Web Token): https://jwt.io/introduction
Timing attacks / constant-time comparison: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timing_attack
C++ coroutines (co_await/co_return): https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/coroutines
HTTP 401 Unauthorized: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/401
